description: Land Acquisition - Yakgahapitiya, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels ('Adhikaram Watta') for a public purpose. It contains detailed land descriptions, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, cadastral map references, and claimant information. The core subject matter is exclusively about land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no mention of government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories.
